description: Qualitative, cited country profiles of internet life circles. No invented percentages.

notes.en: Mainland social life sits inside WeChat (Moments / groups / official accounts), Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou and Weibo. Global Meta / YouTube / Google services are not the default public internet.
notes.zh-Hant: 內地社交生活主要在微信（朋友圈／群／公眾號）、抖音、小紅書、快手與微博。Meta、YouTube、Google 並非大眾預設的公開網絡。

notes.en: WeChat (Weixin) is the default messenger and super-app. Similarweb’s global Android study is a poor fit for China’s app stores.
notes.zh-Hant: 微信是預設通訊工具與超級應用。Similarweb 的全球 Android 研究不太適合中國應用商店環境。

notes.en: Alipay and WeChat Pay are a QR-wallet duopoly for everyday urban payments. UnionPay remains the main card network. CNNIC reports very high online-payment use among internet users. Map this layer as a duopoly, not a single winner.
notes.zh-Hant: 支付寶與微信支付是城市日常二維碼支付的雙寡頭。銀聯仍是主要卡組織。CNNIC 顯示網民網上支付使用率很高。此層應以雙寡頭顯示，而不是單選一個贏家。

notes.en: Baidu is the domestic leader. StatCounter’s China panel is skewed (international / VPN traffic) and should not be quoted as a precise share; even so, independent accounts still put Baidu first, not Google.
notes.zh-Hant: 百度是國內主要搜尋引擎。StatCounter 的中國樣本有偏差（偏國際站與 VPN），不應當成精確市佔；但其他口徑仍顯示百度領先，而非 Google。

notes.en: QuestMobile standalone AI app MAUs in mid-2026 put ByteDance’s Doubao first, then Alibaba’s Qwen, then DeepSeek. ChatGPT is not officially available in mainland China. Rankings are MAU, not referral share.
notes.zh-Hant: QuestMobile 2026 年中獨立 AI App 月活用戶顯示：字節跳動豆包居首，其次阿里通義千問，再次 DeepSeek。ChatGPT 在中國大陸並非官方提供。此為月活排序，不是轉介市佔。

notes.en: The clearest ‘internet nation’: a super-app stack (chat, social, payments, mini-programs) plus a domestic video, search and AI layer.
notes.zh-Hant: 最典型的「互聯網民族」：超級應用（聊天、社交、支付、小程序），再加上本土短視頻、搜尋與 AI。

notes.en: A bilingual, open-web mix: Instagram, Facebook and YouTube are everyday feeds; Xiaohongshu and WeChat are important for mainland-facing life. Not a WeChat-default city.
notes.zh-Hant: 雙語、開放網絡的混合：Instagram、Facebook、YouTube 是日常動態；小紅書與微信在面向內地的生活中很重要。香港並非以微信為預設的城市。

notes.en: WhatsApp is the default group and daily chat. WeChat is widely used with mainland contacts. iMessage is common on iPhones and invisible to Android panels.
notes.zh-Hant: WhatsApp 是預設群組與日常通訊。與內地聯絡常用微信。iPhone 上 iMessage 很常見，但 Android 面板看不到。

notes.en: Octopus is near-universal for transit and many shops. FPS (轉數快) is the bank P2P rail. AlipayHK, WeChat Pay, cards and Apple Pay are also everyday. Treat Octopus + FPS as the distinctive local pair, not a single wallet monopoly.
notes.zh-Hant: 八達通在交通與不少零售場合近乎人人使用。轉數快是銀行即時轉帳軌道。AlipayHK、微信支付、銀行卡與 Apple Pay 也很日常。應把八達通與轉數快視為本地特色組合，而非單一錢包壟斷。

notes.en: Google is the clear referral leader. Bing is a distant second. StatCounter measures referrals, not queries.
notes.zh-Hant: Google 明顯領先轉介流量，Bing 遠遠落後。StatCounter 量的是轉介，不是搜尋次數。

notes.en: ChatGPT is not on OpenAI’s official supported-countries list here. Public, comparable AI-share panels are thin or misleading. The map does not invent a leader.
notes.zh-Hant: 此地不在 OpenAI 官方支援名單。公開、可比較的 AI 佔有率數據薄弱或易誤導。地圖不擅自指定領導產品。

notes.en: An open-web, WhatsApp city with a transit-card soul (Octopus) and a mainland-facing second layer (WeChat, Xiaohongshu, AlipayHK). AI is marked data-poor because ChatGPT is not on OpenAI’s supported list.
notes.zh-Hant: 開放網絡、以 WhatsApp 為主的城市，交通與小額支付靠八達通，同時有面向內地的第二層（微信、小紅書、AlipayHK）。AI 標為資料不足，因為 ChatGPT 不在 OpenAI 支援名單。

notes.en: A smaller market between Hong Kong and Guangdong habits: Facebook / Instagram plus heavy WeChat and Xiaohongshu use. Country-level platform tables are thinner than for Hong Kong.
notes.zh-Hant: 介乎香港與廣東習慣的小型市場：Facebook／Instagram，同時大量使用微信與小紅書。國家級平台表薄於香港。

notes.en: WhatsApp and WeChat are both everyday; treat as a pair rather than a single default. Evidence is thinner than for Hong Kong.
notes.zh-Hant: WhatsApp 與微信都是日常工具，宜視為一對而非單一預設。證據薄於香港。

notes.en: Mainland QR wallets and UnionPay / cards are widely used in a tourism-heavy economy. No single Octopus-like monopoly is claimed here.
notes.zh-Hant: 旅遊比重高的經濟體中，內地二維碼錢包與銀聯／銀行卡很常用。這裡不宣稱存在類似八達通的單一壟斷。

notes.en: Google is the clear referral leader. Bing is a distant second. StatCounter measures referrals, not queries.
notes.zh-Hant: Google 明顯領先轉介流量，Bing 遠遠落後。StatCounter 量的是轉介，不是搜尋次數。

notes.en: ChatGPT is not on OpenAI’s official supported-countries list here. Public, comparable AI-share panels are thin or misleading. The map does not invent a leader.
notes.zh-Hant: 此地不在 OpenAI 官方支援名單。公開、可比較的 AI 佔有率數據薄弱或易誤導。地圖不擅自指定領導產品。

notes.en: Medium confidence: a compact territory with mixed HK / mainland habits. AI officially ChatGPT-unsupported.
notes.zh-Hant: 信心中等：細小地區，習慣介乎香港與內地。ChatGPT 並非官方支援。

notes.en: Facebook, Instagram and YouTube are the main open social / video layer. LINE is also a social surface (official accounts, news) as well as chat.
notes.zh-Hant: Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 是主要開放社交／影音層。LINE 除了聊天，也是官方帳號與新聞等社交場域。

notes.en: LINE is the default messenger (Similarweb 2025 names Taiwan as a LINE #1 market, alongside Japan and Thailand).
notes.zh-Hant: LINE 是預設通訊軟體（Similarweb 2025 將台灣與日本、泰國並列為 LINE 居首的市場）。

notes.en: LINE Pay is often cited as the leading online wallet; JKoPay is strong for offline QR. Cards remain important for higher-value payments.
notes.zh-Hant: LINE Pay 常被視為領先的線上錢包；街口支付在線下 QR 很強。較高金額仍常見刷卡。

notes.en: Google is the clear referral leader. Bing is a distant second. StatCounter measures referrals, not queries.
notes.zh-Hant: Google 明顯領先轉介流量，Bing 遠遠落後。StatCounter 量的是轉介，不是搜尋次數。

notes.en: ChatGPT led AI-chatbot referral share in almost every measured country (May–Jun 2026 average). Gemini is the usual runner-up. Referral data under-counts in-app and workplace use. No precise percentage is shown.
notes.zh-Hant: 在幾乎所有有數據的國家，ChatGPT 都是 AI 對話轉介流量的首位（2026 年 5–6 月平均）。Gemini 多為第二。轉介數據會低估 App 內與職場使用。地圖不標精確百分比。

notes.en: LINE Sphere: LINE for chat (and a wallet), Meta/YouTube for the public feed, Google for search.
notes.zh-Hant: LINE 圈：聊天（與錢包）用 LINE，公開動態用 Meta／YouTube，搜尋用 Google。

notes.en: A distinctive mix: YouTube, X (still culturally strong), Instagram and LINE official accounts. DataReportal notes Japanese users juggle fewer platforms than the global average.
notes.zh-Hant: 組合很特別：YouTube、X（在文化上仍然強勢）、Instagram 與 LINE 官方帳號。DataReportal 指出日本用戶平均使用的平台數低於全球。

notes.en: LINE is the national default messenger (Similarweb 2025; DataReportal carries official LINE user figures).
notes.zh-Hant: LINE 是全國預設通訊軟體（Similarweb 2025；DataReportal 亦載有官方 LINE 用戶數字）。

notes.en: PayPay is the leading QR wallet (LINE Pay ended in 2025 and balances moved to PayPay). Suica / Pasmo / IC cards remain ubiquitous for transit and many small payments. Credit cards still account for a large share of cashless value. Show PayPay + IC, not a cashless-wallet monopoly.
notes.zh-Hant: PayPay 是領先的 QR 錢包（LINE Pay 已於 2025 年結束並將餘額遷至 PayPay）。Suica／Pasmo／交通 IC 在交通與許多小額支付仍然普及。信用卡仍佔無現金支付金額很大比重。應同時顯示 PayPay 與 IC，而非錢包壟斷。

notes.en: Google leads. Yahoo! JAPAN remains a habitual secondary portal; some StatCounter months show a larger Bing share, partly because of Yahoo’s search backend. Do not treat Japan as a Yahoo-majority search market.
notes.zh-Hant: Google 領先。Yahoo! JAPAN 仍是習慣性的次要入口；StatCounter 部分月份 Bing 佔比上升，部分與 Yahoo 的搜尋後端有關。不要把日本當成 Yahoo 佔多數的搜尋市場。

notes.en: LINE Sphere with a uniquely Japanese payments split (PayPay + transit IC + cards) and a still-visible X culture.
notes.zh-Hant: LINE 圈，支付很日本（PayPay＋交通 IC＋信用卡），X 的文化存在感仍在。

notes.en: YouTube and Instagram are the public visual layer; KakaoTalk communities and Naver Cafe / blog are still local town squares. Do not colour Korea as a generic Facebook country.
notes.zh-Hant: YouTube 與 Instagram 是公開視覺層；KakaoTalk 社群與 Naver Cafe／博客仍是本地廣場。不要把韓國畫成普通的 Facebook 國家。

notes.en: KakaoTalk is near-universal (DataReportal 2025 cites Kakao’s own MAU, equivalent to the great majority of internet users).
notes.zh-Hant: KakaoTalk 近乎人人使用（DataReportal 2025 引用 Kakao 自身月活，相當於絕大部分網民）。

notes.en: A competitive wallet field (KakaoPay, Naver Pay, Samsung Pay, Toss) on top of a still-strong card culture. No single wallet is treated as a monopoly.
notes.zh-Hant: 錢包競爭激烈（KakaoPay、Naver Pay、Samsung Pay、Toss），卡支付仍然重要。不把任何一個錢包當成壟斷。

notes.en: CONTESTED. StatCounter referrals often put Google slightly ahead of Naver; InternetTrend and local panels often put Naver well ahead, because much Naver use never leaves Naver as a referral. Show a duopoly / contested fill, not a silent winner.
notes.zh-Hant: 存在爭議。StatCounter 轉介往往顯示 Google 略高於 Naver；InternetTrend 與本地面板則常顯示 Naver 明顯領先，因為大量 Naver 使用不會以轉介離開 Naver。應以雙寡頭／爭議顯示，不要暗中選邊。

notes.en: ChatGPT still leads public AI-referral share; Gemini has been unusually strong here among challengers. Naver Cue: is a relevant local assistant but comparable public share data is thinner.
notes.zh-Hant: 公開 AI 轉介仍以 ChatGPT 為首；在挑戰者之中，Gemini 在韓國相對強。Naver Cue: 是重要的本地助理，但可比較的公開市佔較薄。

notes.en: A self-contained stack: KakaoTalk, Naver (search + pay + community), competitive local wallets, and a contested search lead.
notes.zh-Hant: 自成一套：KakaoTalk、Naver（搜尋＋支付＋社群）、競爭激烈的本地錢包，以及有爭議的搜尋領先者。

notes.en: Facebook remains the main public social network in available regional accounts. Finer platform tables are thinner than for Korea or Japan.
notes.zh-Hant: 現有區域資料仍顯示 Facebook 是主要公開社交網絡。細項平台表薄於韓、日。

notes.en: Messenger / Facebook chat is widely reported as the default; WhatsApp is present. Confidence is medium.
notes.zh-Hant: 多數描述以 Messenger／Facebook 聊天為預設；WhatsApp 也有使用。信心中等。

notes.en: Bank cards and local wallets circulate; this atlas does not assign a single dominant QR brand at high confidence.
notes.zh-Hant: 銀行卡與本地錢包並存；本圖集不以高信心指定單一 QR 品牌。
